qfeplaboratory.name: QFEP Laboratory: The Formula Made Interactive
qfeplaboratory.truth: QFE = F − λE(S) + φΔE(S,t). Life exists at λ ≈ 0.3-0.5.
qfeplaboratory.qfep_connection: The complete QFEP framework made tangible. Interactive sliders for λ (entropy drive) and φ (rate sensitivity). Visualize the oscillation between order and chaos. Find your edge of chaos.
qfeplaboratory.description: The theoretical core of Ada Research made interactive. Manipulate the QFEP parameters directly. See how F, λ, and φ create different system behaviors. Understand why life exists at the edge of chaos.
learning_objectives: F (Free Energy): prediction error, order-seeking, surprise minimization
E(S) (Entropy): possibility space, disorder, freedom from pattern
λ (Entropy Drive): the dial between crystallization and dissolution
φΔE(S,t) (Rate Term): sensitivity to change, the queer signature
Edge of chaos: where λ ≈ 0.3-0.5, where adaptation happens
content: QFEP_Introduction: The formula that unifies the curriculum
F_Term: Free energy—the drive toward prediction and order
Phi_Term: Rate of change—positive φ as queer signature
Edge_Of_Chaos: The sweet spot where life happens
QFEP_Sandbox: Interactive playground with all parameters

phi_slider.visual_feedback: Positive φ = embrace change, negative φ = resist change
